name: oneai
description: OneAI agent — spawn the engine over JSON-RPC, chat + multi-agent scenarios in a webview. The engine binary (`oneai`) is spawned as a child process on activation (Codex/LSP model) — no manual server start.

oneai.oneaiPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `oneai` CLI binary (the engine). Defaults to `oneai` on PATH. The extension spawns `oneai app-server --listen stdio` on activation (Codex/LSP model — you never start a server manually).

oneai.providerKind.markdownDescription: LLM provider kind passed to the engine via env. Real keys come from `oneai.apiKey` / `oneai.baseUrl`.

oneai.apiKey.markdownDescription: LLM API key. Written to `ONEAI_API_KEY` in the spawned engine's env. Leave empty for Ollama (local).

oneai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: LLM base URL → `ONEAI_BASE_URL`. For proxies / Azure / Ollama hosts.

oneai.autoRestart.markdownDescription: Restart the engine child process with exponential backoff if it exits unexpectedly.
